evidence: Raman scattering spectroscopy has been used in conjunction with XRD method to study ZrO2 and HfO2 films grown by ALD on silicon substrates in chloride-based processes. X-ray diffraction patterns are used to define the structure of metastable phases. Complementary Brillouin light scattering measurements of the freestanding edges are also employed in constraining elastic properties of the 405 nm HfO2 thin film.
